name: g_versionNumber
notes: Game version x100 (logged as %i.%i by CConsoleThread::OnStart).

name: g_objectAgeStart
notes: 0xd8 in the image: UpdateEnvironment's landscape pass turns objects from this value up to 0xdf into (Random & 1) + (object + 0x4a) * 2 (an object life cycle stage). Name from that use only.

name: g_screenWidth
notes: Width of the game view in pixels (used by GameWorld::ScreenCenterTileX/Y with the camera position). Name from that use only.

name: g_screenHeight
notes: Height of the game view in pixels (GameWorld::ScreenCenterTileX/Y).

name: g_minimapWidth
notes: Width (and height) of the minimap in pixels, 0x80 in the image; UpdateMinimapSlice 0x4fb520 scales the map to it.

name: g_minimapMode
notes: 0: territory colours by owner; otherwise terrain colours lit by shade (1: only water and land). Read by MinimapPixel 0x4fb720.

name: g_minimapShowBuildings
notes: Non-zero: MinimapPixel marks building footprints (tile flags 8). Name from that use only.

name: g_minimapShowSettlers
notes: 0: no settlers on the minimap; 2: every settler; other: settlers whose type has an entry in 0x658f64 (MinimapPixel 0x4fb720).

name: g_gameOutcome
notes: Set to -1 at the end of 0x4fd0d0 (a loop over the player records, purpose unknown), then to a result by the game-end check 0x511c50 (per-mission cases set 1 or 0, or a function's return value). GameWorld::IsGameOutcome1 tests for 1. Which value means won is not confirmed.

name: g_gameSettings
notes: Global object; word +0x88 (0x7a7aa0) is the game random seed, passed to GameWorld::SeedRandom by CLogicThread::OnStart. Filled from the settings struct at [0x7e2eb0]+0x364 by 0x567910 (origin of the value not traced; srand(time) at 0x431852 is a candidate).

name: g_buildInfo
notes: Written in CConsoleThread::OnStart from 0x60eff0; logged as two %x values next to the version.

name: g_optionRecord
notes: Set by the -record command-line option (CConsoleThread::OnStart). Copied to CNetThread+0x89 / CNetBounceThread+0x59: write commands to Siedler3.evt.

name: g_optionPlay
notes: Set by the -play command-line option. Copied to CNetThread+0x8a / CNetBounceThread+0x5a: add commands from Siedler3.evt (on top of the live ones).

name: g_pileClaimsCursor
notes: Cursor 0..127 into the 128 pile claims at world+0x1195dd4 (pile_claims): the logic thread clears that slot and advances it every step (0x53de6f); GameWorld::AddPileClaim (0x510770) searches downwards from the slot before it. Was g_recentPositionsCursor. Reset by 0x4fcce3. Per step, not per tick.

name: g_simulationPaused
notes: When non-zero, CLogicThread::Step skips the world updates. Name is a hypothesis (pause or not-yet-started).

name: g_playerColourIndex
notes: Per player the index of its colour in the RGB table 0x7ace90 (three uint32 per entry), used by MinimapPixel.

name: g_strengthDivisor
notes: Set by the map and savegame loaders (0x4fd0fb, 0x50911d); UpdateEnvironment computes Player::soldier_strength from 0x600 / (value + 4) plus goods. Probably a game setting; name from that use only.

name: g_playerTallies
notes: Per-player tallies, probably end-of-game statistics: +0x0 meals eaten by miners (MinerJobFood 0x4f9b80), +0x4 successful digs (MinerJobDig 0x4fa220), +0x8 points (+4 for resource 0x40 by race 1 in MinerJobDig, +2 in UpdateSettlers); +0xc is g_playerCounters7acfe0 (same records).

name: g_playerCounters7acfe0
notes: Per player (stride 0x44), element 0 += 8 by BuildingDone (0x4dbc50) when a temple-like building (types 0x29/0x2b/0x2d/0x37) is finished and the player flag bit 0 (player +0x8) is clear; also read/written by UpdateEconomy (0x4e34a2, 0x4e35c5). Meaning unknown.

name: g_minimapSliceDirty
notes: Set to 1 by UpdateMinimapSlice 0x4fb520 for the slice it recomputed (probably read by the drawing code).

name: g_worldUpdateDisabled
notes: When non-zero, GameWorld::UpdateEnvironment returns immediately and CLogicThread::Step skips its game-end check.

name: g_syncRandomHistory
notes: CLogicThread::Step stores the RNG a-word here when the tick low byte is 0 (index (tick>>8)&31) and sends it via 0x4309c0: probably the lockstep desync check.

name: g_pixelChannelShifts
notes: Shift counts of the three colour channels in the screen's pixel format, followed by their scale factors at 0x7dfbac..0x7dfbb4 (Render::PackColour 0x4c7b00: (c * scale) >> 8 << shift per channel).

name: g_stepCountdown
notes: Checked and decremented in CLogicThread::Step; when non-zero some per-phase calls (0x51f110) are skipped. Purpose unknown.

name: g_fastForwarding
notes: Set by CLogicThread::Step while g_stepCountdown catches up (0x53dc80), 0 otherwise; UpdateEnvironment then skips the fog of war cycle (and resets its counter) and the minimap.

name: g_logicStartState
notes: CLogicThread::Step does one-time setup when this equals 0xFA, then sets it to 0.

name: g_gameTick
notes: Simulation tick counter; copied from CLogicThread+0x70 at the end of each CLogicThread::Step. Used throughout the world update (e.g. tick & 0x3f, tick % 220).

name: g_revealMap
notes: Non-zero while the whole map is shown: UpdateFogSlice 0x519010 then draws fog level 7 everywhere; set by the reveal spell 0x5495d0 for the local player and by CLogicThread (0x53b34e, 0x53d5fc).

name: g_campaignMission
notes: Number of the running campaign mission, 0 outside campaigns (CrushBuilding compares it with 70 next to "Campaign 70: ..."; MinerJobDig and UpdateSoldier weaken computer players in campaigns together with config byte +0x189).

name: g_aiPlayerData
notes: Working data of the computer player whose turn it is (from CComputerPlayer +0x778, set by AI::SetCurrentPlayer 0x551a30); candidate records at +0x26 + i*6 and per-type words at +0x2d2 (AI::RecordBestCandidate).

name: g_aiPlayerSetup
notes: 0x731488 + index * 0x180 with the index from CComputerPlayer +0x770 (AI::SetCurrentPlayer): probably the player's entry of a settings table.

name: g_aiPlayerNumber
notes: Player number of the current computer player (CComputerPlayer +0x272, AI::SetCurrentPlayer).

name: g_aiPlayer
notes: The CComputerPlayer whose turn it is (AI::SetCurrentPlayer 0x551a30; cleared by 0x551b80).

name: g_aiWorld
notes: The world (CGameData) as the computer players see it, from CComputerPlayer +0x75c (0x551b80, which also copies the map size to the words 0x7e3412/0x7e3414). Used by AI::IsOnMap, ClampToMap, AreaGoodsAmount, GetBuilding.
